what: The first run of AUTO_SCHEDULED_SWEEP after both halves of ITEM-45 were applied: the index pass of 2026-09-05 and the bounded 30-day window in the 09:02:19 export. It is the observation ITEM-45 was held open for.

source.capture: the operator's run summary, pasted verbatim into the session

whatThisEstablishes.thresholdFailureIsClosed: CONFIRMED. Get_Due_Breached and Get_Ack_Overdue sit inside Scope_Due_Breached and Scope_Ack_Overdue; both scopes report Succeeded and the error list is empty. The 400 'exceeds the list view threshold' that ITEM-45 records did not recur. Indexing alone could not have achieved this — the 05:57:10 export filtered all history on a 15,804-item list — so this is the bounded window and the index together.
whatThisEstablishes.theSweepRuns: CONFIRMED. The estate now has a working scheduled trigger, which ITEM-49 recorded as its largest structural gap.

whatThisDoesNotEstablish.howMuchMailWentOut: The summary reports scope outcomes, not counts. The run took 9 minutes 50 seconds, which is long for six SharePoint reads over empty result sets, so it is likely the Foreach bodies did work. A first run carries no dedupe history — Get_Sent_Due and Get_Sent_Ack find nothing — so every row passing Filter_Due_Open could send. Bounded at $top 500 per action. Check Portal Outbox Receipts for what was actually sent.
whatThisDoesNotEstablish.theSixthScope: The flow carries six scopes; this summary names five. Scope_Flow_Data_Capture is not reported. Absent from the summary is not the same as absent from the run, and nothing here says which.
whatThisDoesNotEstablish.correctness: That the right people received the right messages. This records that the queries no longer fail, not that the notifications are right.
